_comment: WARP-2540 — registered statement shapes for the ERP SQL bridge.
One skeleton per registered statement (per SET-width for writes), as
emitted by the canonical registries in @droplet/erp-connector
whitespace collapsed. Identifiers are masked because the registries
resolve PHYSICAL identifiers through the per-practice introspected schema
map — the template is the invariant, the names are not.
edit a registry, re-run that suite, and copy its printed manifest here.

get_schedule_today: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>.<id> WHERE <id> >= ? AND <id> < ? ORDER BY <id>
find_patient: SELECT <id>, <id>, <id> FROM <id>.<id> WHERE <id> LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY <id>, <id>
get_ar_summary: SELECT COUNT(<id>) AS account_count, SUM(<id>) AS total_balance FROM <id>.<id>
get_ap_summary: SELECT COUNT(<id>) AS vendor_count, SUM(<id>) AS total_balance FROM <id>.<id>
